requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation is currently a minimal pass-through that does not actually hook Flask applications. This prevents Flask view functions and error handlers from being intercepted and recorded.
requirement.contract: Implement the Flask hook to properly integrate with Flask applications by ensuring that Flask view functions and error handlers are intercepted and recorded. The hook should detect Flask apps and apply the generic hook mechanism to relevant functions.

requirement.description: The generic hook's Flask detection logic is insufficient. It doesn't properly identify and hook Flask route functions and error handlers from Flask applications.
requirement.contract: Improve the Flask detection logic in list_callables_from_module to properly identify Flask applications, their view functions (decorated with @app.route), and error handlers (decorated with @app.errorhandler). The hook should ensure these functions are properly decorated with the generic hook mechanism.
